Author: thatbard (original by ahadev)
Name: Courteous Eorzea
Description:
Courteous Eorzea sends a greeting or a farewell to your party (or alliance) from your own list of messages.

• /hi and /bye send a random greeting or farewell right away.
• Auto mode greets when you enter an instanced duty and says thanks when it completes.
• Picks party or alliance chat automatically; skips solo duties.
• Fully editable message lists, delays and triggers in /courteous.

Courteous Eorzea is a modified version of Polite Eorzea by ahadev (github.com/AHAKuo/FFXIVPoliteEorzea), licensed under AGPL-3.0.
Punchline: Say hello and thank your party with one command, or automatically in duties.
